# Glossary This section contains some term or explains meaning of words more thoroughly. This list is not exhaustive.
## Mechanical and other useful terms:
- [bold]Admeme[/bold] - Can refer to an [bold]admin event[/bold] or an [bold]admin[/bold] - [bold]AFK[/bold] - Away from keyboard. - [bold]Agmin/Min[/bold] - Admin - [bold]Amag[/bold] - Access breaker. - [bold]AOS[/bold] - attack on sight. - [bold]Cata[/bold] - Catatonic - when a player has ghosted or suicided in character. - [bold]Clake[/bold] - China Lake. - [bold]Cogni[/bold] - Cognizine a chem used to give a creature sentience - [bold]Distro[/bold] - Distribution - Atmos term for setting up breathable air - [bold]DNR[/bold] - Do not revive - [bold]Emagged/Emag[/bold] - Cryptographic sequencer, used on electronics to hack them into doing unusual things - [bold]EORG[/bold] - End of round griefing - [bold]Grav[/bold] - Gravity Generator - [bold]Loose/Tesloose/Singuloose[/bold] - To describe when a Tesla or Singularity becomes loose - Station level destruction may follow. - [bold]Wardloose/Hoploose[/bold] - To describe when the Warden/Head of personnel have left their post. - [bold]KOS[/bold] - Kill on sight. - [bold]OOC[/bold] - Out of character - To speak out of character. - [bold]LOOC[/bold] - Local out of character- To use a method of speaking out of character while in character. - [bold]RDM[/bold] - Random death match - To randomly kill people. - [bold]SSD[/bold] - Sudden Sleep Disorder - when a player has disconnected from the game or went AFK. - [bold]SM[/bold] - Supermatter Crystal - [bold]TC[/bold] - Telecrystal - a limited currency that the traitor and nuclear operative antagonist use. - [bold]TEG[/bold] - Thermal electric generator. - [bold]Warops/War[/bold] - Part of the nuclear operatives game mode the team leader has an option to declare war on the station blowing their cover by announcement made to the station, however they are rewarded additional TC for it. - [bold]Valid[/bold] - Whether something is allowed by the rules, sop or space law. Alternate use is when referring to an antagonist to say that he is “valid to hunt” such as nukies or ascended heretics.
## Command Role terms: - [bold]Cap[/bold] - Captain - [bold]BSO[/bold] - Blue Shield Officer - [bold]Cburn[/bold] - Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear response team. - [bold]CE[/bold] - Chief Engineer - [bold]CCO[/bold] - Central Command Official - [bold]CMO[/bold] - Chief Medical Officer - [bold]ERT[/bold] - Emergency Response Team - [bold]HOP[/bold] - Head of Personnel - [bold]HOS[/bold] - Head of Security - [bold]NTR[/bold] - Nanotrasen Representative - [bold]QM[/bold] - Quartermaster - [bold]RD[/bold] - Research Director - [bold]DS[/bold] - Deathsquad - [bold]Capsec[/bold] - Referring to when captain acts as a security member - [bold]Redshield/Bluesec[/bold] - Referring to when the Blueshield Officer decides to act as a security member
## Crew Role Terms:
- [bold]AI[/bold] - Artificial Intelligence - Usually refers to the stations AI role. - [bold]Atmos[/bold] - Atmospheres Technician or atmospherics in general - [bold]Chem[/bold] - Chemical often synthesised in Med or a chemist - [bold]Det[/bold] - Detective - [bold]Engi[/bold] - Engineer - [bold]Shit’x’[/bold] - Often referring to a department or crew member being shit e.g shitmed, shitsec, shitengi, shitcap etc. - [bold]Shitmed[/bold] - Can refer to medical or medical system - [bold]Seccie[/bold] - Security officer - [bold]Shitcurity[/bold] - Insult for security or a security officer. - [bold]Techie[/bold] - Cargo Technician or Tech Assistant. - [bold]TA[/bold] - another term for “Tech assistant”.
# Antag terms: - [bold]Coscult[/bold] - Cosmic Cultists - [bold]Ling[/bold] - Changeling - [bold]Sling[/bold] - Shadow ling (not to be confused with lings) - [bold]Slinged[/bold] - Shadow ling thrall - [bold]Nukie/Nukeop/bloodred[/bold] - Nuclear Operative(s) - [bold]War ops[/bold] - Nuclear operatives who have declared war - [bold]Stealth ops[/bold] - Nuclear operatives who have not revealed themselves - [bold]Clown ops[/bold] - Nuclear operatives who have chosen the honkmother - [bold]Rev[/bold] - Revolutionary - [bold]Syndicate[/bold] - Member of the syndicate, associated with antagonists - [bold]ToT/TT[/bold] - Traitor
## General spoken Terms: - [bold]65[/bold] - Goob™ meme - When one uses their power for evil. Those who know. - [bold]Antag/Ontag[/bold] - Antagonist. - [bold]Ick Ock[/bold] - In character, out of character - to speak about something that is out of character while in character - [bold]Robust[/bold] - To be highly skilled in click combat - [bold]Recognizable[/bold] - At first glance, the subject can be clearly identified without confusion or ambiguity. - [bold]Self-antag[/bold] - Choosing to indulge in antagonist actions despite not being an antagonist - [bold]Shitter[/bold] - Player who often plays to be a nuisance. - [bold]“X” go loud[/bold] - Common phrase for antagonists or shitter players to cause disruption or chaos. - [bold]Mald[/bold] - To be particularly upset about something, often vocally in LOOC or OOC - [bold]Fent[/bold] - What admins take to put up with your shit
